sourceTitle: Sun Dried Tomato and Garlic Dressing
sourceText:
Sun Dried Tomato and Garlic Dressing
By: Kristi Rimkus
Published: Tuesday, November 2, 2010 - 6:48am

Ingredients




1 cup light mayonnaise
1 cup 2%% milk
6 medium sun dried tomatoes packed in oil and drained
2 cloves garlic, chopped
2 tablespoons onion, chopped

Preparation

1 Combine ingredients in a blender until smooth, then chill for 30 minutes.

About


Sweet sun dried tomatoes and garlic make for a sweet and spicy combination. Perfect for dipping!
